author: Elaine Kurtenbach
title: Why investors are bracing as the Bank of Japan raises interest rates
description: Global investors are bracing after the Bank of Japan raised its key interest rate Friday to a 30-year high. The central bank had been widely expected to raise its benchmark rate Friday by 0.25 percentage points to 0.75%. That's still low by most standards, bu…
